title: App Studio 改版（1-3）：精简版软件包概览页——菜单第一项「概览」带待发布数字，信息页签只读、待发布页签接住发布，「⋯」软件包菜单搬进页头
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: topic #37424 — parent decision 9 and the maintainer's pick 「按推荐启动」 of phase 1 with the top-bar tenants' homes (2026-11-26 05:57Z, quoted on #37451). Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 1, P1-3).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 (takes the parent's grade) · evidence: the parent's decisions, mockups (#37424 comment 7181963746) and the current shell read on origin/main 7d50dc8b.
Reader: area `ux-37424` (seat `repo:objectstack#5`), an `os-dev` subagent or card thread after the blockers land.

Blocked-by: #37451

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：Studio 菜单第一项是「概览」，旁边显示待发布的数量。点进去是这个软件包的详情页，页头是名称、系统自带/可写、使用中/已停用，再加原来的「⋯」菜单。下面两个页签：「信息」（只读，技术字段收起）和「待发布」（原来顶栏上的发布面板搬到这里）。
- 为什么在第一阶段：顶栏要去掉，发布得先有新家，否则只能临时塞一个按钮。
- 不在这张卡：发布历史页签、页头动作重排、编辑信息——第二阶段的完整概览页再做。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- A package overview page in Studio, reusing the item-detail header and tab frame (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioItemHeader.tsx`). It reads through the package REST surface (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` ~546–598). ⛔ No `package` metadata type (decision 9).
- Header: name, a 系统自带 or 可写 chip, a 使用中 or 已停用 chip, the description, and `StudioPackageMenu` moved here as is (its items unchanged; disable / enable / delete keep pointing at Setup until question 1 on #37424 is answered).
- Tabs: **Info** (read-only business fields; id, namespace, type folded away) and **Pending** (the existing `DraftChangesPanel` / publish flow, unchanged behaviour, moved from the top bar).
- Menu: 概览 is the first entry (`studioMenuModel.ts`), with the pending count as a badge that opens the Pending tab.
- Save semantics (epic #36510, ruled 2026-11-22): a person's Save goes live at once; draft plus whole-package publish is for AI changes only. So the Pending tab and the 概览 badge count AI drafts, and the copy says so.
- The top-bar Publish button may stay until P1-5 removes the bar, so nothing is ever missing; P1-5 deletes it.

## Acceptance

- Mockup 4 (`Overview.png`) for the header and Info tab, within this card's scope.
- Publishing from the Pending tab behaves exactly as from the top bar today (existing publish tests re-pointed, not weakened).
- A read-only (system-shipped) package shows the lock / read-only posture the existing rules give it.

Governing text: `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md` as amended by #37451; `docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md`.
